name: Post-Matric Scholarship
description: College students ke liye scholarship support.
steps: Apni Aadhaar details link aur verify karein.
Application submit karke college verification complete karein.

name: Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Kisanon ke liye aarthik sahayata yojana.
steps: Farmer Corner mein 'New Farmer Registration' par click karein.
Aadhaar aur zameen ki details bharkar submit karein.

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Street vendors ke liye working capital loan yojana.
steps: Apna mobile number aur Aadhaar verify karein.
Loan application form bharkar submit karein.

name: Mudra Yojana
description: Chhote aur madhyam udyamiyo ke liye business loan.
steps: Apne nazdiki bank branch mein jayen ya Udyamimitra portal kholen.
Apne business proof aur documents bank mein jama karein.
